goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Konzepte von Nachhaltigkeit (sozial/ökologisch/ökonomisch) einordnen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three equally visible environmental, social and economic dimensions are joined around a repair-workshop question. The dimensions are conceptually appropriate and contain no quantitative shares or guaranteed win-win; however, the central actor's labelled planning notebook is facing the audience rather than that actor.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the three dimension labels, central thinker and repair scenes remain recognisable without the smaller supporting texts.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px all three dimensions and their repair examples are clear; the notebook text remains visibly audience-facing.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The planning notebook in front of the person has upright audience-facing text. From the seated person's position behind it, this text is upside down, contrary to the explicit actor-perspective requirement.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.description: Central planning notebook text is upright for audience but upside down for its seated owner.
blockingFindings.targetedCorrection: Rotate only the notebook's writing 180 degrees to face the actor, or replace it with an appropriate simple planning symbol without mandatory text; keep dimensions, composition and style.

interpretationLimits: The repair workshop is an example relating the dimensions, not a claim every dimension always improves together.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
